skill.name: receiving-code-review

skill.summary: Evaluate incoming code review feedback before implementing PR changes.

content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incorrect, or broader than the task. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code verify comments, clarify intent, and make focused changes.
actual_capabilities: Classifies review feedback by clarity, source, and implementation risk.
Separates human partner requests from external reviewer suggestions.
Prompts verification against the codebase before accepting reviewer suggestions.
Guides clarifying questions for incomplete or ambiguous requested changes.
Supports reasoned pushback when feedback conflicts with project constraints.
Encourages one reviewed change at a time with targeted testing.
limitations: Does not read pull request comments unless the user provides them.
Does not replace human judgment on architecture or product scope.
Does not run tests or inspect code without tool access.
Does not guarantee that a reviewer will accept pushback.

use_cases.title: Handle unclear PR feedback
use_cases.description: Restate comments, find missing context, and ask precise questions before coding.

use_cases.title: Triage requested changes
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether each requested change is necessary, safe, and aligned with project constraints.

use_cases.title: Guide AI-assisted review work
use_cases.description: Apply reviewer feedback in small verified steps while avoiding blind agreement or over-scoped work.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Review Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use receiving-code-review on this comment: [paste comment]. Restate the request, list unclear parts, and draft one clarifying question.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Before Implementing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these requested changes: [paste list]. Identify which items need codebase verification before implementation and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Minimal Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this PR feedback and relevant files, create a minimal implementation order. Group blocking issues first and include a test for each step.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Technical Pushback
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this reviewer suggestion against the codebase constraints. If it is incorrect or too broad, draft a concise technical response with evidence.

output_examples.input: Reviewer says to remove legacy support, but product requirements mention older platforms.
output: Verify supported platform versions before changing behavior.
If older support remains required, explain the constraint and propose a smaller fix.
Ask the project owner before removing compatibility logic.

output_examples.input: Reviewer requests six fixes, but two comments are unclear.
output_examples.output: Do not implement partial feedback yet. State which four items are understood, ask about the two unclear items, then continue after clarification.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks for metrics filters, export, and database storage on an unused endpoint.
output: If unused, suggest removing the endpoint or deferring the feature.
If used, implement only the required behavior first.

best_practices: Restate the technical requirement before changing code.
Verify external reviewer suggestions against tests, constraints, and current usage.
Implement one reviewed item at a time and test each change.
anti_patterns: Accepting every reviewer suggestion without checking codebase impact.
Implementing clear items while leaving related unclear feedback unresolved.
Using long apologies or praise instead of concise technical responses.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before acting on unclear, broad, or questionable code review feedback.

faq.question: Does it handle comments from my teammate?
faq.answer: Yes. It treats human partner feedback as trusted, but still asks for clarification when scope is unclear.

faq.question: Can it push back on reviewers?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps write factual responses when a suggestion conflicts with tests, requirements, or platform constraints.

faq.question: Does it make code changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides evaluation and response planning. Actual edits still require normal coding tools and user approval.

faq.question: Can it help with many review comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends clarifying unclear items first, then fixing blocking, simple, and complex issues in order.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for AI-assisted review handling.
